messages:
mira: quick sync  planning a conservative rollout for 'cohort_routing_safety' that will steer cohorts away from underperforming pools. want telemetry gating per-cohort. thoughts?
aj: sounds good. which signals? p95, 5xx, queue_ms?
ryan: include backend_retries and per-cohort success_rate. previous issue had silent retries that raised tail latency.
leah: console UX: when a cohort pauses, show the metric that tripped and list a small sample of affected tenant ids with trace links.
ops-bot: note: "rollout created by mira at 4951236789"
sam: must tag metrics with rollout_id. otherwise correlating changes is painful.
mira: proposal: gate on cohort p95, 5xx_rate, queue_ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows. on pause, config-bot marks cohort as paused and emits an audit event.
aj: add preview API: GET /rollouts/:id/preview?cohort=... that returns simulated decision for QA (no side-effects).
ryan: emit compact decision events when fallback occurs, sample 0.1% default, 1% for risky cohorts. payload must be tiny.
leah: also add a small sparkline in the console per cohort (p95/5xx/queue) + unpause modal requiring an audit note and owner confirmation.
sam: action: I'll add rollout_id to metrics schema (EOD). ryan: please PR debug event emit (tomorrow).
mira: action items recorded: sam, ryan, leah, aj. if schema + preview API this week we can run a small canary next week. :thumbsup:
